tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Use this when a traveler asks which See Sight Tours day tour, private tour or multi-day trip fits a city, country, starting point, length or interest. tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Use this when the traveler wants the facts about one See Sight Tours product: what is included and excluded, the itinerary, meeting point or pickup, cancellation terms, price options and the right page to book or request it. For a multi-day trip it returns the full day-by-day itinerary with overnigh

tools.name: plan_itinerary
tools.description: Use this when a traveler wants a day-by-day plan from a starting city for a number of days (optionally an end city, start date and interests). Returns packaged See Sight Tours trips that fit the route and a day-tour plan from the base city, and lists which prices or dates need a dated quote. Do not

tools.name: customize_itinerary
tools.description: Use this when a traveler wants to change a See Sight Tours multi-day trip: remove, add or reorder days, swap an activity or hotel, set the start date or the party, or split one trip into two separate itineraries. Start from a trip id (search_products or get_product) or from the plan_id of an earlier

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Use this when the traveler has picked a product and a date and wants open times and the exact total for their party. Reads live seats and prices; returns each departure's status, the total in minor units (cents) and an opaque price-lock reference (quote_id) for get_checkout_link. Dates must be real

tools.name: get_checkout_link
tools.description: Use this when the traveler confirms a quoted departure and wants to book. Returns a short-lived link to a review page on seesight-tours.com that restores the product, departure, party and currency; the guest confirms the final total there and pays on the website at the website price. tools.name: get_quote_link
tools.description: Use this when a product is booked by request (most multi-day trips, private or custom dates) or the traveler wants a quote. Returns the See Sight Tours request form link; the traveler enters contact details and consent there. No payment is taken.

tools.name: check_checkout_link
tools.description: Use this when the traveler asks whether a checkout link from this app still works. Returns prepared, expired or invalid. It cannot see payments or bookings: the confirmation email and the See Sight Tours site are the booking record.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_checkout_link" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_checkout_link, check_checkout_link · Private data: search_products, get_checkout_link, get_quote_link, check_checkout_link · Public sink: check_checkout_link · Destructive: customize_itinerary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_checkout_link, check_checkout_link · Private data: search_products, get_checkout_link, get_quote_link, check_checkout_link · Public sink: check_checkout_link · Destructive: customize_itinerary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
